# Model card — M3 Transolver

*Generated by `scripts/make_model_cards.py` on 2026-09-07 from committed `results/` metrics (seed means over untagged core runs). Regenerate rather than hand-editing the tables.*

## 1. Model details

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Architecture | M3 Transolver |
| Design follows | Transolver-style physics attention (Wu et al., 2024) |
| Reimplementation? | **Yes** — reimplemented in plain PyTorch, not run from the authors' code; absolute numbers are not comparable with published ones |
| Encoder | physics attention: soft-assign N points to M=32 slices across 4 attention layers at width 128, attend among slice tokens, scatter back |
| Parameters | 1,281,701 |
| Task | surface fields (p, tau_w) + coefficient head (C_L, C_D); C^int by quadrature of the predicted fields |
| Training | Adam 1e-3 cosine, batch 16, 400 epochs, fp32, lambda_H=0.1 head term; per-split train-only normalisation |
| Training cost | 0.41 GPU-h per run (Tesla T4, `full` split) |
| Inference | 1.75 ms per simulation (CPU-measured harness value) |

Coverage must be read next to width; a wide band can cover without informing (see the paper's calibration section and docs/RESULTS.md 3.1).

## 4. Intended use

Surrogate predictions of surface pressure/shear and drag for NACA 4/5-digit sections *inside* the AirfRANS envelope (Re 2-6e6, alpha -5..+15 deg, attached flow), with FSC monitored as a label-free out-of-distribution flag on every prediction.

## 5. Do not use for

- Treating its accuracy lead as trust: on the two flow-regime shifts its 90% conformal intervals covered only 0.42 of independent Fluent cases at moderate angles (Table 5 of the paper).
- Any use of the integrated drag as a ranking signal: 0.89 in distribution (no better than ridge), collapsing to 0.28 under the combined shift.
- Anything post-stall or outside the AirfRANS envelope: verified errors ~600-900x in-distribution against an independent solver.

## 6. Provenance

- Training data: AirfRANS (ODbL-1.0); split manifests in `data/splits/`.
- Every number above: `results/<run_id>/metrics.json` and `results/uq/*.json` at the commit this file was generated at.
- Full protocol, caveats and the external Fluent check: the paper (`paper/`) and `docs/RESULTS.md`.
